Name: Huge Sheds Redux
Author: zagreboldrin
Description:
[b][color=#00ff00]Latest Update:[/color][/b]
I've included a version of the shed with hidden lighting as an optional download.
This is for people who want their shed to always be bright without worrying about putting in their own lighting.


[color=#00ff00][b]About The Mod:
[/b][/color]This is an improvement/fix of the "Huge Sheds" mod by Blue_Starkiller (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1218) as they appear to have abandoned it.
This fixes the incorrect texturing, and removes the dependency on Advanced Location Loader by simply having you walk to the attic/basement.
Other improvements include more stairs for moving between areas.


[color=#00ff00][b]Room Counts/Sizes:
[/b][/color]3 - 11x10 rooms
2 - 10x10 rooms
2 - 54x18 rooms
1 - 41x10 room


[b][color=#00ff00]Installation:
[/color][/b]To install, simply replace your Shed.xnb file in your "Stardew Valley/Content/Maps" game folder.
Be careful not to replace other shed files in other folders, this will cause your game to crash.
It is recommended you make a backup of your Content folder before you attempt installation in case you accidentally replace the wrong file.


[b][color=#00ff00]Known Issues:
[/color][/b]The in-game redecoration of rooms with wallpaper and flooring is a [b]game mechanic [/b]that cannot be altered with a simple map edit. This is a well-known issue with Stardew Valley modders that these areas are hidden away in the game code as opposed to being part of the map data. You will not be able to redecorate these rooms without modifying the map yourself in a map editor.

If you absolutely cannot stand the color schemes I slapped together (understandable, I'm not the keenest on house design), and are stumped by trying to modify the map, leave a post on discussion portion of this page detailing what you'd like to see. I'll try and accommodate as best as possible.
